title: Lorenz Curve – Income Inequality
subject: Economics
caption: Lorenz curve showing cumulative population versus cumulative income share with the line of perfect equality.
altText: A graph with white background, axes labeled 'Cumulative Population %' (horizontal) and 'Cumulative Income %' (vertical). A gray dashed diagonal line from the origin (0%,0%) to (100%,100%) represents perfect equality. A blue curved line (Lorenz curve) bows below the diagonal, indicating that lower‑income groups receive a smaller share of total income. The curve starts at (0%,0%) and ends at (100%,100%).
